# Error codes

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask codegen`. Do not edit: change
`model/overlays/error-status.toml` and regenerate. -->

Every code this gateway may put in the `<Code>` element of an `<Error>` body, and the HTTP
status it is answered with. `model/overlays/error-status.toml` is the only place that
pairing is written by hand; this file and `generated/error_codes.json` are renderings of
it, and `cargo xtask spec verify` fails when either has drifted from it.

There is no fallback row. A code with no entry here has no constant and no status, and
reaches the wire only through `ErrorCode::custom`, which makes its caller name the status.

121 codes: 3 redirect, 114 client, 4 server.

## The 5xx allowlist

A 5xx tells an SDK to retry and trips its circuit breaker, so a client error that lands in
the 5xx band is amplified into an outage. Every code below carries `server_fault = true` in
the authority, and `scripts/check_error_status_total.sh` refuses the flag without the band
and the band without the flag. Nothing else in this document is retried on the status
alone.

| Code | Status | Constant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `InternalError` | 500 | `ErrorCode::INTERNAL_ERROR` |
| `NotImplemented` | 501 | `ErrorCode::NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |
| `ServiceUnavailable` | 503 | `ErrorCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| `SlowDown` | 503 | `ErrorCode::SLOW_DOWN` |
